items.title: Repo, folder structure, Gradle multi-module skeleton
items.goal: Create the module layout and Gradle wiring so every later task touches one module.
acceptance: All modules in settings.gradle.kts exist with MODULE.md and build.gradle.kts
First CI run succeeds (human confirms green run)
Versions recorded in DECISIONS.md (done 2026-11-10)
Package id + minSdk confirmed with human

items.title: AGENTS.md, PROJECT_SUMMARY.md, task-card template
items.goal: Give any LLM enough context to work in one session.
acceptance: AGENTS.md, PROJECT_SUMMARY.md, DECISIONS.md, CODING_STANDARDS.md exist and are each <= 2 pages
Agent + slash commands present under .claude/

items.title: Build tools: header checker, context map, size check
items.goal: Automate the conventions so LLM drift is caught.
acceptance: check_headers.py fails on a headerless file and passes on the repo
gen_context_map.py writes docs/CONTEXT_MAP.md
check_size.py compares an APK/AAB to budgets.json

items.title: CI pipeline: build, lint, tests, budget report
items.goal: Run checks automatically on every push.
acceptance: Workflow runs header check, context map, Gradle test, assembleDebug
Debug APK uploaded as artifact 'angel-debug-apk'
Human confirms first green run on GitHub

items.title: Google Play policy review and declarations plan
items.goal: Know the Play requirements for screen capture, overlay, foreground services before building.
acceptance: docs/spikes/F-08.md lists applicable policies (MediaProjection, overlay, foreground service types, AccessibilityService for Phase 2) with source links the human verified
Declarations/disclosures checklist for MVP and Phase 2
Questions for human listed

items.title: Threat model for misuse (scam, coercion)
items.goal: Define abuse cases and the mitigations the MVP must implement.
acceptance: docs/THREAT_MODEL.md: actors, abuse cases, mitigations mapped to backlog IDs
Safety invariants in AGENTS.md reviewed and extended if needed

items.title: Distribution: signed APK, release hosting, in-app update check
items.goal: Initial release is a directly installed APK (no Play approval needed). Define signing, hosting and update flow.
acceptance: Release signing process documented (key stored outside repo, never committed)
Install guide for Users: allow-unknown-source steps in plain language
Update check design that adds no idle background work (check only when app is opened)
Size impact of any update code recorded in DECISIONS.md

items.title: Design system: colours, type, large-text mode, core components
items.goal: One consistent, accessible UI kit used by all features.
acceptance: Theme (light/dark/high contrast), large-text scaling, primary button, Stop button, status chip, big-card list
Previews compile; no hard-coded UI values elsewhere

items.title: Spike: MediaProjection + WebRTC screen stream; measure size/RAM/latency
items.goal: Prove screen share works within budgets and learn the real APK cost of WebRTC.
acceptance: Spike app streams User screen to Angel device
docs/spikes/F-05.md has measurement checklist; human records APK size (arm64), idle/active RAM, latency, 30-min battery
Conclusion + library choice recorded in DECISIONS.md

items.title: Spike: signalling + TURN on free tier; document limits
items.goal: Choose the signalling/invite backend and relay with real quotas.
acceptance: Compare Cloudflare Workers, Firebase, Supabase (free-tier limits verified by human from official pages)
Minimal signalling prototype for the shortlisted option
Provider decision + abstraction note in DECISIONS.md

items.title: Spike: draw-over-apps overlay for guidance on 4 OEMs
items.goal: Confirm overlay guidance works and is policy-safe across vendors.
acceptance: Spike draws arrow/highlight/text overlay over other apps
docs/spikes/F-07.md matrix for 4 devices filled by human
Go/no-go + fallback recorded in DECISIONS.md

items.title: User research: 8-10 older adults and families
items.goal: Validate flows and wording before building UI.
acceptance: Interview guide + prototype test script in docs/research/
Human runs sessions; findings summary in docs/research/findings.md

items.title: Role selection: User or Angel mode
items.goal: First-run choice persisted locally.
acceptance: Role stored; changeable in settings
Unit test for role state

items.title: Invite generation (link, QR, short code)
items.goal: User/Angel can create and redeem an invite.
acceptance: Invite = short code + QR + link, expiring
Backend call behind core-api InviteService interface
Tests with fake service

items.title: Pairing with two-sided confirmation
items.goal: Both sides must confirm before an Angel is trusted.
acceptance: Pairing state machine with tests
Both-side confirmation screens (plain language)
New Angel stored with cool-off start time

items.title: Capability model and permission engine
items.goal: Pure-Kotlin rules engine: who may do what, for how long.
acceptance: Capabilities: VIEW_SCREEN, DRAW_GUIDANCE, VOICE_CHAT (MVP) with registry for future ones
Grants: per-Angel, per-capability, duration; revoke
No Act capability can be granted in MVP; unit tests for all rules incl. cool-off

items.title: Multiple Angels and per-Angel permission profile
items.goal: Manage several Angels, each with own grants.
acceptance: List/add/remove Angels
Edit grants per Angel (MVP capabilities only)

items.title: Session request and wake-up via push
items.goal: Angel requests a session; User device wakes via FCM only.
acceptance: No persistent socket when idle
Push -> consent screen deep link
Rate limit session requests

items.title: Per-session consent prompt screen
items.goal: Clear prompt: who, what capabilities, Allow/Deny.
acceptance: Large-text friendly; shows Angel identity and requested capabilities
Result goes through permission engine; audit event emitted
Pre-approve only low-risk caps for trusted Angel

items.title: Foreground service and persistent session indicator
items.goal: Service exists only during an active session; indicator cannot be dismissed.
acceptance: Notification + on-screen badge with Angel name and mode
Service stops on end; no wake locks outside session
Test lifecycle

items.title: Always-visible Stop control and instant revoke
items.goal: User can end any session instantly.
acceptance: Stop in notification and on-screen badge
Revoke ends session < 1 s and tears down media
Audit event emitted

items.title: Screen share from User device (view only)
items.goal: Stream screen to Angel with adaptive quality.
acceptance: MediaProjection consent per session
Adaptive bitrate; active RAM <= 200 MB on test device
Interface in core-api; WebRTC details hidden

items.title: Angel viewer screen with pan and zoom
items.goal: Angel sees User's screen comfortably.
acceptance: Pan/zoom, orientation handling
Shows connection state

items.title: Voice channel
items.goal: Two-way voice during session.
acceptance: Mic permission explained; mute button
Stops with session

items.title: Guidance overlay: arrow, highlight, text
items.goal: Angel draws; User sees overlays on top of other apps.
acceptance: Overlay permission flow explained in plain language
Overlay cleared on session end/revoke
Overlays are non-interactive (cannot capture touches)

items.title: Shortcut: open system setting deep link
items.goal: Angel sends a settings destination; User taps once.
acceptance: Catalogue of safe settings intents (Wi-Fi, display, sound, battery, notifications, accessibility)
Fallback when intent unavailable on an OEM
Audit event per shortcut

items.title: Shortcut: compose message draft
items.goal: Angel drafts text; User reviews and sends.
acceptance: Uses ACTION_SENDTO/share intent; never sends automatically
Audit event

items.title: Mask sensitive screens (secure windows, password fields)
items.goal: Sensitive content never reaches the Angel.
acceptance: FLAG_SECURE windows blank; password fields masked where detectable
Documented limits in MODULE.md

items.title: Cool-off period for new Angels
items.goal: New Angels get only Watch/Guide for 24h.
acceptance: Enforced in engine; tests
Plain-language explanation shown to User

items.title: Local activity log and viewer
items.goal: Tamper-resistant local log of sessions and actions.
acceptance: Append-only encrypted store; no sensitive content
Simple list UI; export/share optional later

items.title: Onboarding flow with plain-language permission explainers
items.goal: Guide first-time Users through setup.
acceptance: Each Android permission explained before request
Large-text mode offered on first screen
Findings from F-11 applied if available

items.title: Text chat
items.goal: Chat during session.
acceptance: Messages not persisted by default; large text

items.title: Shortcut: contact search
items.goal: Open contacts search for a name.
acceptance: Intent-based; no contact data leaves device

items.title: Shortcut: maps search
items.goal: Open maps search for a query.
acceptance: geo: intent; location sharing stays separate

items.title: Shortcut: calendar event
items.goal: Prefilled calendar event the User confirms.
acceptance: Insert-event intent; User confirms

items.title: Reconnect and graceful degradation
items.goal: Survive network drops.
acceptance: Auto reconnect; degrade frame rate then audio-only

items.title: Block and report
items.goal: User can block an Angel and report abuse.
acceptance: Block removes grants and ends sessions; report payload excludes screen content

items.title: Accessibility pass
items.goal: Large text, screen reader, contrast, dark mode across all screens.
acceptance: TalkBack labels on every control; 200% font scale OK
Checklist in docs/spikes/M-26.md

items.title: Performance pass: size, RAM, battery budgets
items.goal: Meet all budgets on target devices.
acceptance: Release build with R8; ABI/AAB split; baseline profile
Measurements in docs/spikes/M-27.md recorded by human; all within tools/budgets.json

items.title: Session verification code (proposed, needs approval)
items.goal: Phone shows a 4-digit code the Angel must provide at session start to prove identity.
acceptance: Code shown on User screen, entered/spoken by Angel before view starts
Expires in 2 minutes; 3 wrong tries ends request
Human approved the added friction (THREAT_MODEL Q1: yes, 2026-10-08)

items.title: Closed beta with 10 real families
items.goal: Validate MVP release criteria.
acceptance: Beta plan, feedback form, success metrics in docs/beta/
Release criteria from MVP doc evaluated

items.title: Accessibility service shell with policy-compliant disclosure
Remote text entry, back, home, recents
Remote photo capture with preview and approval
Local storage and optional share of captures
